brief: Goldman's vol-trading desk (Robbie Stankard) reports clients positioning for what it expects to be an extremely busy fall. After a sharp vol reset the desk sees a bid for Tech upside across single stocks and index, and at the same time a noticeable uptick in hedging ahead of a seasonally harder period for equities and renewed geopolitical tension. The recommendation follows from both observations: pair optimistic tech views with portfolio hedges while near-term vol is at these levels. Bottom-up, implied vols have reset on improved AI sentiment and recent leverage reduction and positioning unwinds, so upside expressions and stock replacement screen favorably across TMT. NDX 'avg stock' implied vol has fallen about 20 vol points since mid-July to near YTD lows. Five trades follow: AMAT Oct 520 calls at $8.75, IGV upside used to fund SMH upside, IWM 30Sep 300 calls at $2.48 ahead of an NFP Goldman puts below the +40k street consensus, QQQ Sep 725 calls at $4.01, and VIX 21Oct26 20/30 call spreads at $1.00 as the book hedge. Dealer gamma is estimated still very long, a source of index support. Bonus trade: Brazil (EWZ) Dec26 35/38 call spread buying into elections.
